entry_points.text: Read and fault entries are generic dispatcher, buffered and splice readers, hole locator, fault-around installer, fault handler and large installer.
Write dispatch handles privilege, time, direct with buffered fallback, plus invalidation helpers and cachestat syscall with fd and permission checks.

exports.text: Buffered read uses fast path then batches, rejects negative offsets and stops at max; dispatcher selects direct or buffered with iterator restore; splice caps by pipe capacity.
Hole/data locator walks cache; invalidation unmaps once then per-folio invalidates with DAX sync; sync helpers wait for stable range; utilities slice to pipes, flush caches and unmap intervals.
Faults supply locked folios with retry handling; table installers publish small and upper entries; file and new-anon rmap link folios; LRU helper inserts new folios.
Generic VM ops supply fault, fault-around and write-prepare handlers; sync cache wrappers fetch folio or page at index with default or caller constraints.
Legacy page helpers forward unlock, writeback end, writeback wait and access marking to containing folio.

hazards.text: Lockless copy must not fault and orders observations for reuse; buffered paths sample mapped state once and size after validity; fault-around skips poisoned and markers.

Readahead and direct input may drop protection requiring retry; missing aux table reports OOM; bad anon range or hugetlb is caller error; missed post-direct invalidation warns; shmem shadows may vanish.
Fault status encodes major/minor, locked, retry, bus error, OOM, fallback and no-page; huge uses upper mask and order; MMAP_LOTSAMISS is one hundred.
Mmap reports ENOEXEC without read support and ENOSYS where unsupported; readonly over shared-writable reports EINVAL; mkwrite without support reports SIGBUS.
External helpers for sizes, iterators, locks and upkeep defined outside this dossier.

invariants.text: Lockless read needs uptodate without readahead or dropbehind; batches disable faults, validate by ordered reloads, size after validity; dropbehind only if clean with trylock.
Hole probing decides on exceptional or valid entries else block-scans under lock; order0 skips poisoned or occupied slots; fault-around clamps to size and cuts miss count on hit.
Readahead adjusts miss history except sequential and exec; huge needs THP plus area and mapping support capped at 2M; exec clamps and disables async; scan needs stable current attachment.
Fault folios need same mapping, index and size under lock; PMD refused for disabled THP, misalignment, wrong order, poison or race; large folio expands only when fully inside area and one table.
Write faults dirty only where writable; file rmap rejects anon and mlocks whole coverage only; locked lists for pure mlocked areas; uffd inherited, prefault young.
Anon uses tagged pointer and linear index; mmap needs read support, readonly rejects shared-writable; direct write invalidates with fallback; cachestat scans by order with owner-or-writable check.

locks.text: Invalidation locks mapping only for walk, unmaps before folio work and yields between batches; fault-around uses RCU then table lock; mkwrite holds freeze protection; inode blocks inserts and discards range.
Fault folio prefers trylock, NOWAIT returns held, else pins and drops once before wait; file faults hold shared invalidate protection; revalidate emptiness lockless then locked.
Small install serializes on upper lock with retest; upper install holds lock through rmap to publish; generic write serializes under inode lock with sync.
Non-exclusive anon must be locked by caller, exclusive relaxes; locked accounting batches under per-cpu lock and flushes when full or disabled.

state_machines.text: Fast read repeats bounded batches from prior-end page with signal checks; slow loop yields, converts async after partial success, skips beyond-end and releases refs each pass.
Faults report bus error, OOM, fallback, no-page, locked success or retry; upper mapping prefers huge then small table; readahead selects disabled, huge, sequential, exec or read-around.
Cached read retries on race, contention or truncation until uptodate; buffered write loops in chunks with throttling, signal checks, atomic copy and source fault for bad addresses.

structs.text: Splice record carries pipe ops, page, offset and length; anon stores tagged pointer in mapping and linear offset in index.
Readahead holds budget, misses, window and order; fault descriptor links area, offset, access, address, page, tables, locks, prealloc, mask and original entry.
Cachestat query carries offset and length with resident, evicted, recently evicted, dirty and writeback counters.
